statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-54513 makes BasicPolymorphicTypeValidator.Builder.allowIfSubTypeIsArray() accept an array without validating its component type. The staged 1.6.0.1 image uses fixed jackson-databind 2.21.5 on the application classpath; Scout identifies the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 PURLs only inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing either relocated databind package, and no enableDefaultTyping, activateDefaultTyping, or allowIfSubTypeIsArray call outside the relocated Jackson classes. The vulnerable shaded code therefore has no execution path in this image.

The staged 1.6.0.1 image uses fixed jackson-databind 2.21.5 on the application classpath; Scout identifies the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 PURLs only inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing either relocated databind package, and no enableDefaultTyping, activateDefaultTyping, or allowIfSubTypeIsArray call outside the relocated Jackson classes. The vulnerable shaded code therefore has no execution path in this image.

CVE-2026-59889 is an @JsonView authorization bypass for properties also annotated with @JsonUnwrapped. The staged 1.6.0.1 image carries the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 copies only as relocated classes inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar; the application classpath uses fixed jackson-databind 2.21.5. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing the relocated databind packages, but the shaded copies remain under investigation pending an upstream Hazelcast update.

The built image SBOM locates jackson-databind 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar in nifi-hazelcast-services-nar, and jackson-databind 2.21.3 inside parquet-jackson-1.17.1.jar in nifi-iceberg-parquet-writer-nar. NiFi's Maven dependency management cannot directly replace these embedded copies. Remediation requires upgrading the enclosing artifacts: Parquet 1.18.0 embeds jackson-databind 2.22.1 but requires compatibility validation, while Hazelcast currently has no newer release that embeds fixed jackson-databind 2.x and 3.x versions.

CVE-2026-59889 requires jackson-databind 2.21.5 (2.x line) and 3.1.5 (3.x line). These versions were not yet published to Maven Central at the time of this VEX statement (July 22, 2026). Standalone jackson-databind copies in the Spring Boot fat jar are forced to 2.21.4 and tools.jackson 3.1.4 during the image build, which partially mitigates the issue. Remaining findings are shaded inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar (2.21.2 / tools.jackson 3.1.2) or parquet-jackson-1.17.1.jar (2.21.3/2.21.4). Awaiting upstream publication of 2.21.5 and 3.1.5 to complete remediation.
